fact: The AML/CFT/P (Miscellaneous Provisions) Bill, introduced on 2 July 2024 and passed on 18 July 2024, requires the Registrar of Companies to keep a Beneficial Ownership Register with owners' names, addresses, ID numbers, nationality and ownership structure, open to competent authorities.
title: The Anti-Money Laundering and Combatting the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act – Beneficial Ownership Information
